reason: User explicitly requested original pure-ColNomic failures and a link to OCR, beyond the31 newly harmed cases. Cohort and arms fixed before inspecting pixel intervention scores.
core_population: All247 original image failures +31 subject-readout harms +31 matched successful controls=309
extended_population: The31 subject-readout harms and31 successful controls=62
fresh_gallery: Original reference embeddings remain fixed for all query interventions. Fresh original queries are checked against old query tensors. Exact old-query parity permits interpreting query-side interventions against historical scores; it does not reconstruct the reference encoder's internal history.
analysis: Full-gallery image-only ranking, same-candidate locked/free matching, input-patch-unchanged stage changes, and repair/harm intersections with existing OCR variants. No text score participates in pixel-arm ranking.
repeat: Lossless sham is separately encoded for every query. When a cohort phase is resumed, fresh original encoding must exactly equal the saved original.
area_controls: Extended matched-background and matched-subject masks have the same pixel count; not the same area as the much larger far-background mask. No claim they are semantically matched or identity-free.
